name: Wrap the MCP surface in defense-in-depth protection -- harden the M365 MCP gateway (own-attack-surface, gateway-first) + the inter-agent broker
description: Andrew-direct 2026-06-25 (triggered by the BD /otp/fetch auth-model decision generalizing to 'is the whole MCP surface hardened?'). SCTY workstream #3 (own-attack-surface red-team, 'the OPLMCP gateway first') turned into a concrete, prioritized hardening BUILD. The M365 MCP gateway (mcp.opalinvest.dev) is the highest-value single target in the estate: it brokers Andrew's FULL delegated Graph envelope (Mail/Files/Calendar/Teams read+WRITE) to Claude, holds the crown-jewel secrets (RS256 signing key, App-2 Graph secret, Fernet cache key), and is going live (OPLMCP STEP-C). FRAMING (load-bearing): the gateway is ALREADY substantially hardened (RS256 no-downgrade + strict per-resource audience guard, PKCE-S256, loopback-DCR, Fernet-at-rest, no app-only token, kill-switch+blocklist, audit lake, IMDSv2, scoped IAM) -- PREMCP resolves the GAPS, does NOT re-pave. Grounded risk-surface inventory -> prioritized resolutions: P0 = token REVOCATION (leaked 30d refresh token has no kill path), the VA-signature verify=False TODO, the /otp machine-route auth model (RULED Option A static capability bearer -- arch-GO), secrets-rotation SOP; P1 = write-scope entitlements (full Mail.Send/Files.ReadWrite granted, no second gate), per-resource scope split, rate-limiting/size/timeout, WAF; P2 = network (private subnet/drop public IP), the opal-agent-comms broker review. SCOPE: gateway PRIMARY + broker SECONDARY; OUT = Graph API itself + the agent-fabric prompt-injection class (SCTY #4, separate). Defensive hardening of OWN infra. The /otp ruling (section 4 of the PRD) unblocks the BD durable auto-login.

items: H-class network-exposure: NEW OIDC-exempt ALB path /ms/{sites,site_children,onedrive_children,search,health} (rule ms_ingest_capability priority=31, infra/aws/terraform/m365-mcp-gateway/ms-ingest.tf) -- forwards WITHOUT authenticate-oidc, gated ONLY by static MS_INGEST_BEARER (read-only-by-construction). A-class bearer surface: MS_INGEST_BEARER (secret opal/mcp/ms-ingest-token) -- new credential for the A1 revocation + A2 least-scope token inventory; derive is its reference consumer.

3rd-layer read-only-scope-token TO (Andrew's server-layer-scoping refinement, CTO-deferred to PREMCP = B2): the derive is the natural FIRST consumer of per-consumer read-only gateway-capability scoping (Sites.Read.All/Files.Read.All, never Files.ReadWrite.All) -- destructive impossible at the permission layer.
